sections.title: Campaign delivery
sections.sql: select name,client,opportunities,claimed_wins,current_live,overdue from campaign_desk order by name

sections.title: Follow-ups needing review
sections.sql: select name,campaign,owner,next_due,eligible from opportunity_desk where next_due<=current_date and milestone not in ('won','lost','paused') order by next_due

sections.title: Latest manual observations
sections.sql: select name,campaign,page_url,state,observed_on,stale,qualification_gap from placement_desk order by name

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select rule,name,finding from compliance_desk order by rule,name
